parameters.name: SAEH2E
parameters.description: Indicates if the BSS will support Simultaneous Authentication of Equals (SAE) hash-to-element {{true}}, or not {{false}}. {{true}}: BSS sets SAE hash-to-element to 1. {{false}}: BSS sets SAE hash-to-element to 0.

object.description: This object indicates the value the BSS transmits in the RSNXE element. This object is only used by the Configuration Template Manager if the {{param|#.SecurityIEs}} is empty.
